maddeler.e:
تعجرفت (form IIq)
# تَعَجْرَفْتُ (taʕajraftu) /ta.ʕad͡ʒ.raf.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
# تَعَجْرَفْتَ (taʕajrafta) /ta.ʕad͡ʒ.raf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
# تَعَجْرَفْتِ (taʕajrafti) /ta.ʕad͡ʒ.raf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَجْرَفَ (taʕajrafa)
# تَعَجْرَفَتْ (taʕajrafat) /ta.ʕad͡ʒ.ra
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
